from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, validator
from pydantic.config import ConfigDict
from typing import List, Union

class Article(BaseModel):
    title: str
    tags: List[str] = Field(..., alias='tags')

    @validator('tags', pre=True)
    def parse_tags(cls, v):
        if isinstance(v, str):
            return [tag.strip() for tag in v.split(',') if tag.strip()]
        return v

    class Config:
        model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)

# Example usage:

    article1 = Article.model_validate({"title": "Example", "tags": ["python", "pydantic"]})
    print(article1.model_dump())

    article2 = Article.model_validate({"title": "Example", "tags": "python, pydantic, agents"})
    print(article2.model_dump())

    article3 = Article.model_validate({"title": "Example", "tags": "a,,b"})
    print(article3.model_dump())
